title: One Person Lab Windows x64 安装与配置教程
machine_boundary: Machine-readable Windows x64 guide manifest. Human-readable prose is maintained in docs/guides/windows-app-install/guide.qmd. The public GitHub Latest Release, platform manifest, updater receipt, App release contracts, and separate installed/runtime acceptance evidence remain machine truth. The guide must not copy a version-specific tag, asset name, size, digest, or direct tag URL. Asset publication does not prove WSL2 runtime acceptance, installed behavior, signing, or supported-platform completion.
audience: 希望在 Windows 11 x64 电脑上安装当前公开 One Person Lab Desktop 资产的用户。
intro: 本文说明如何下载、校验和安装当前公开的 Windows x64 Desktop 资产，并区分 release publication 与 runtime/installed acceptance 边界。

publishing.pdf_engine_reason: The current shared Chinese guide template uses the verified xelatex path for deterministic HTML/PDF publication.
